title: Breaking and Entering: Melbourne's Gym For Synths MESS Celebrates 10 Years
summary: MESS (Melbourne Electronic Sound Studio) celebrates its 10th anniversary this year! Co-founders Byron Scullin and Robin Fox join Lauren in the studio to reflect on the creation of their "living museum". Located in Federation Square, MESS houses a significant collection of new and historic electronic instruments and preserves them for use by musicians from all over the world.
